<script>
 function ageCheck() {
   var min_age = 18;  // Set the minimum age. 
   var year =   parseInt(document.getElementById('byear').value);
   var month =  parseInt(document.getElementById('bmonth').value);
   var day =    parseInt(document.getElementById('bday').value);
   var theirDate = new Date((year + min_age), month, day);
   var today = new Date;
   if ((today.getTime() - theirDate.getTime()) < 0) {
     window.location = 'http://google.com'; //enter domain url where you would like the underaged visitor to be sent to.
   } else {
     var days = 14; //number of days until they must go through the age checker again.
     var date = new Date();
     date.setTime(date.getTime()+(days*24*60*60*1000));
     var expires = "; expires="+date.toGMTString();
     document.cookie = 'isAnAdult=true;'+expires+"; path=/";
//      location.reload();
     $("#prompt-background").hide();
   };
  };
  function readCookie(name) {
    var nameEQ = name + "=";
    var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
    for(var i=0;i < ca.length;i++) {
      var c = ca[i];
      while (c.charAt(0)==' ') c = c.substring(1,c.length);
      if (c.indexOf(nameEQ) == 0) return c.substring(nameEQ.length,c.length);
    }
    return null;
  };
  var isAnAdult = readCookie('isAnAdult');
  if (isAnAdult) {
    document.write("<style> #prompt-background { display: none; }</style>");
  };
</script>

Don’t worry, though, CBD is a non-psychoactive compound so <strong>CBD does not get you high</strong>. The psychoactive component of cannabis is called THC, and while it does have some of its own medicinal properties, it’s an intoxicating experience that not everybody wants or needs.</span></p><p><span><strong>CBD VS THC</strong></span></p><p>A common misconception is that CBD comes from the marijuana plant. While you can get CBD from a marijuana plant, it is most often extracted from the hemp plant (a cousin of the marijuana plant).</p><p>Keep in mind, any CBD made from the marijuana plant is illegal because that species of plant is illegal. Any CBD derived from hemp is legal in the 47 states who have legalized it.</p><p>The biggest difference between CBD and THC is how they react with the human endocannabinoid system. While CBD will give you some of the amazing benefits associated with using marijuana, it will not give you the buzzed feeling!</p><p><strong><span>Where does CBD come from?</span></strong></p><p><span>CBD is a compound commonly found in cannabis plants, but it does not create any of the psychotropic effects that people typically associate with cannabis. Everything you’ll find in the VaporDNA CBD Store is going to be derived from hemp, which is the male version of the plant that generates negligible amounts of THC, essentially eliminating any psychoactivity.</span></p><p><strong><span>How does CBD work? How can I benefit from it? </span></strong></p><p><span>CBD supports and stimulates your endocannabinoid system. The endocannabinoid system is a series of receptors all throughout the human body that require cannabinoids to achieve balance. This system affects everything from your mood to how well you’ll be able to fight off certain viruses.</span></p><p><span>Studies have shown that CBD can shrink cancer cells and is often used by people that commonly experience seizures, but it can also help with relatively minor problems such as muscle pain, headaches, or anxiety. </span><span>It’s anti-inflammatory properties make CBD perfect for muscle soreness, and the anti-anxiety effects can help with relaxation, among many other positive effects.</span></p><p><strong><a href="https://vapordna.com/blogs/news/is-cbd-legal" rel="noopener" target="_blank" title="CBD Blog Article"><span style="color: #3d85c6;">Isn’t cannabis illegal?</span></a></strong></p><p><span>Yes… but also no. What’s illegal is marijuana, the female version of the plant that creates an abundance of both THC and CBD when cultivated correctly. These are the plants that are legal in states where cannabis is legal recreationally, as they can serve both recreational and medical purposes.</span></p><p><span>When we’re talking about CBD, however, we’re talking about a compound that can also be found in hemp, the male version of cannabis that creates negligible levels of THC(0.3%), eliminating the “high” that people might be avoiding. Hemp-derived CBD is legal in all 50 states in the US, Canada, and many European countries among other places around the globe. </span></p><p><strong><span>How much is one dose of CBD?</span></strong></p><p><span>The dosage will vary depending on the severity of the ailment. It’s often recommended to start with something between five and ten milligrams for your first dose of CBD. If you’re using it for pain, try something on the higher end of that scale at first, as you want to make sure it takes care of the problem to avoid discomfort. Don’t worry, though, CBD is a non-psychoactive compound so <strong>CBD does not get you high</strong>. The psychoactive component of cannabis is called THC, and while it does have some of its own medicinal properties, it’s an intoxicating experience that not everybody wants or needs.</span></p><p><span><strong>CBD VS THC</strong></span></p><p>A common misconception is that CBD comes from the marijuana plant. While you can get CBD from a marijuana plant, it is most often extracted from the hemp plant (a cousin of the marijuana plant).</p><p>Keep in mind, any CBD made from the marijuana plant is illegal because that species of plant is illegal. Any CBD derived from hemp is legal in the 47 states who have legalized it.</p><p>The biggest difference between CBD and THC is how they react with the human endocannabinoid system. While CBD will give you some of the amazing benefits associated with using marijuana, it will not give you the buzzed feeling!</p><p><strong><span>Where does CBD come from?</span></strong></p><p><span>CBD is a compound commonly found in cannabis plants, but it does not create any of the psychotropic effects that people typically associate with cannabis. Everything you’ll find in the VaporDNA CBD Store is going to be derived from hemp, which is the male version of the plant that generates negligible amounts of THC, essentially eliminating any psychoactivity.</span></p><p><strong><span>How does CBD work? How can I benefit from it? </span></strong></p><p><span>CBD supports and stimulates your endocannabinoid system. The endocannabinoid system is a series of receptors all throughout the human body that require cannabinoids to achieve balance. This system affects everything from your mood to how well you’ll be able to fight off certain viruses.</span></p><p><span>Studies have shown that CBD can shrink cancer cells and is often used by people that commonly experience seizures, but it can also help with relatively minor problems such as muscle pain, headaches, or anxiety. </span><span>It’s anti-inflammatory properties make CBD perfect for muscle soreness, and the anti-anxiety effects can help with relaxation, among many other positive effects.</span></p><p><strong><a href="https://vapordna.com/blogs/news/is-cbd-legal" rel="noopener" target="_blank" title="CBD Blog Article"><span style="color: #3d85c6;">Isn’t cannabis illegal?</span></a></strong></p><p><span>Yes… but also no. What’s illegal is marijuana, the female version of the plant that creates an abundance of both THC and CBD when cultivated correctly. These are the plants that are legal in states where cannabis is legal recreationally, as they can serve both recreational and medical purposes.</span></p><p><span>When we’re talking about CBD, however, we’re talking about a compound that can also be found in hemp, the male version of cannabis that creates negligible levels of THC(0.3%), eliminating the “high” that people might be avoiding. Hemp-derived CBD is legal in all 50 states in the US, Canada, and many European countries among other places around the globe. </span></p><p><strong><span>How much is one dose of CBD?</span></strong></p><p><span>The dosage will vary depending on the severity of the ailment. It’s often recommended to start with something between five and ten milligrams for your first dose of CBD. Don’t worry, though, CBD is a non-psychoactive compound so <strong>CBD does not get you high</strong>. The psychoactive component of cannabis is called THC, and while it does have some of its own medicinal properties, it’s an intoxicating experience that not everybody wants or needs.</span></p><p><span><strong>CBD VS THC</strong></span></p><p>A common misconception is that CBD comes from the marijuana plant. While you can get CBD from a marijuana plant, it is most often extracted from the hemp plant (a cousin of the marijuana plant).</p><p>Keep in mind, any CBD made from the marijuana plant is illegal because that species of plant is illegal. Any CBD derived from hemp is legal in the 47 states who have legalized it.</p><p>The biggest difference between CBD and THC is how they react with the human endocannabinoid system. While CBD will give you some of the amazing benefits associated with using marijuana, it will not give you the buzzed feeling!</p><p><strong><span>Where does CBD come from?</span></strong></p><p><span>CBD is a compound commonly found in cannabis plants, but it does not create any of the psychotropic effects that people typically associate with cannabis. Everything you’ll find in the VaporDNA CBD Store is going to be derived from hemp, which is the male version of the plant that generates negligible amounts of THC, essentially eliminating any psychoactivity.</span></p><p><strong><span>How does CBD work? How can I benefit from it? </span></strong></p><p><span>CBD supports and stimulates your endocannabinoid system. The endocannabinoid system is a series of receptors all throughout the human body that require cannabinoids to achieve balance. This system affects everything from your mood to how well you’ll be able to fight off certain viruses.</span></p><p><span>Studies have shown that CBD can shrink cancer cells and is often used by people that commonly experience seizures, but it can also help with relatively minor problems such as muscle pain, headaches, or anxiety. </span><span>It’s anti-inflammatory properties make CBD perfect for muscle soreness, and the anti-anxiety effects can help with relaxation, among many other positive effects.</span></p><p><strong><a href="https://vapordna.com/blogs/news/is-cbd-legal" rel="noopener" target="_blank" title="CBD Blog Article"><span style="color: #3d85c6;">Isn’t cannabis illegal?</span></a></strong></p><p><span>Yes… but also no. What’s illegal is marijuana, the female version of the plant that creates an abundance of both THC and CBD when cultivated correctly. These are the plants that are legal in states where cannabis is legal recreationally, as they can serve both recreational and medical purposes.</span></p><p><span>When we’re talking about CBD, however, we’re talking about a compound that can also be found in hemp, the male version of cannabis that creates negligible levels of THC(0.3%), eliminating the “high” that people might be avoiding. Hemp-derived CBD is legal in all 50 states in the US, Canada, and many European countries among other places around the globe. </span></p><p><strong><span>How much is one dose of CBD?</span></strong></p><p><span>The dosage will vary depending on the severity of the ailment. It’s often recommended to start with something between five and ten milligrams for your first dose of CBD. If you’re using it for pain, try something on the higher end of that scale at first, as you want to make sure it takes care of the problem to avoid discomfort. For issues such as anxiety, try something lighter but do it more often to keep the CBD working in your system all day if that’s what you need.</span></p><p><strong>What is the best way to intake CBD? </strong></p><p>CBD products come in a variety of options and a wide range of potencies. Don’t worry, though, CBD is a non-psychoactive compound so <strong>CBD does not get you high</strong>. The psychoactive component of cannabis is called THC, and while it does have some of its own medicinal properties, it’s an intoxicating experience that not everybody wants or needs.</span></p><p><span><strong>CBD VS THC</strong></span></p><p>A common misconception is that CBD comes from the marijuana plant. While you can get CBD from a marijuana plant, it is most often extracted from the hemp plant (a cousin of the marijuana plant).</p><p>Keep in mind, any CBD made from the marijuana plant is illegal because that species of plant is illegal. Any CBD derived from hemp is legal in the 47 states who have legalized it.</p><p>The biggest difference between CBD and THC is how they react with the human endocannabinoid system. While CBD will give you some of the amazing benefits associated with using marijuana, it will not give you the buzzed feeling!</p><p><strong><span>Where does CBD come from?</span></strong></p><p><span>CBD is a compound commonly found in cannabis plants, but it does not create any of the psychotropic effects that people typically associate with cannabis. Everything you’ll find in the VaporDNA CBD Store is going to be derived from hemp, which is the male version of the plant that generates negligible amounts of THC, essentially eliminating any psychoactivity.</span></p><p><strong><span>How does CBD work? How can I benefit from it? </span></strong></p><p><span>CBD supports and stimulates your endocannabinoid system. The endocannabinoid system is a series of receptors all throughout the human body that require cannabinoids to achieve balance. This system affects everything from your mood to how well you’ll be able to fight off certain viruses.</span></p><p><span>Studies have shown that CBD can shrink cancer cells and is often used by people that commonly experience seizures, but it can also help with relatively minor problems such as muscle pain, headaches, or anxiety. </span><span>It’s anti-inflammatory properties make CBD perfect for muscle soreness, and the anti-anxiety effects can help with relaxation, among many other positive effects.</span></p><p><strong><a href="https://vapordna.com/blogs/news/is-cbd-legal" rel="noopener" target="_blank" title="CBD Blog Article"><span style="color: #3d85c6;">Isn’t cannabis illegal?</span></a></strong></p><p><span>Yes… but also no. What’s illegal is marijuana, the female version of the plant that creates an abundance of both THC and CBD when cultivated correctly. These are the plants that are legal in states where cannabis is legal recreationally, as they can serve both recreational and medical purposes.</span></p><p><span>When we’re talking about CBD, however, we’re talking about a compound that can also be found in hemp, the male version of cannabis that creates negligible levels of THC(0.3%), eliminating the “high” that people might be avoiding. Hemp-derived CBD is legal in all 50 states in the US, Canada, and many European countries among other places around the globe. </span></p><p><strong><span>How much is one dose of CBD?</span></strong></p><p><span>The dosage will vary depending on the severity of the ailment. It’s often recommended to start with something between five and ten milligrams for your first dose of CBD. If you’re using it for pain, try something on the higher end of that scale at first, as you want to make sure it takes care of the problem to avoid discomfort. <h3 class="stamped-review-header-title">Nice machining; comfortable to use; wish it had more power</h3>
<p class="stamped-review-content-body">I like the overall build quality of the mod -- very well made. It's comfortable to use in both 18350 and 18650 modes. Wish the output voltage was a bit higher in 19650 mode. Best for low power MTL, which I don't often do.
</p>

<h3 class="stamped-review-header-title">Good little mod</h3>
<p class="stamped-review-content-body">The mods works pretty good for a MTL device. The chip
Limits the voltage output but with the right build it does the job. I have a .62 coil in it and it does fine. I love the size.</p>

<p><b>Only Pod System You Will Ever Need!</b></p>
<p><b>#ValueMatters #BestBangForYourBuckPod #First10DollarsPod #RedefineAffordability #VapeandSmile #VapeWhileSave #EcoFriendlyVape #VaporDNACares #VaporDNAFirstPod</b></p>
<p style="text-align: left;">The SUPERGOOD by <span>VaporDNA</span> is an affordable <span style="color: #3d85c6;"><a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/pod-systems" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color: #3d85c6;" target="_blank" title="Shop all vape pod systems">pod system</a></span> that has two power output modes, a 460mAh battery, and <span style="color: #3d85c6;"><a href="https://vapordna.com/products/supergood-replacement-coils" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color: #3d85c6;" target="_blank" title="SUPERGOOD Replacement Coils">replacement coils</a></span> for its <span style="color: #3d85c6;"><a href="https://vapordna.com/products/supergood-replacement-cartridge" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color: #3d85c6;" target="_blank" title="SUPERGOOD Replacement Cartridge">pod</a></span>. This device will give users amazing flavor due to the restricted, yet comfortable airflow. Being constructed with zinc alloy and polycarbonate, the SUPERGOOD excels at both durability and lightweight applications.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">The SUPERGOOD features a mutli-angular chassis with rounded edges. An LED light indicator is located on the bottom of the device and will only activate when the device is fired. This LED light indicator will light up green if the integrated 460mAh battery on the device is above 3.5V and it will light up red if it is lower than 3.5V. Located on the side of the SUPERGOOD, adjacent to the LED light indicator is a USB cable port; This cable port is only meant for charging and takes approximately 60 minutes to fully charge the device. An unique feature implemented on the SUPERGOOD is a variable output mode system, Strong and Normal. To switch between the two output modes, users must draw on the device five times within five seconds and the LED light will correspond to the mode; Green is normal mode while White is strong mode. Normal Mode runs the SUPERGOOD at 10W while Strong Mode runs the device at 15W; Both output modes are suited for the atomizer resistance of 1.1 ohms.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">The SUPERGOOD uses a proprietary replacement pod and coil system. This replaceable pod can accommodate a maximum of 2ml <span style="color: #3d85c6;"><a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/nicotine-salt-ejuices" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color: #3d85c6;" target="_blank" title="Shop all Nicotine Salts">Nicotine Salt</a></span> E-Liquid, regular <span style="color: #3d85c6;"><a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/e-liquids" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color: #3d85c6;" target="_blank" title="Shop all E-liquids">freebase E-liquid</a></span> or <span style="color: #3d85c6;"><a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/cbd-vape-juice" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color: #3d85c6;" target="_blank" title="CBD Vape Juice Collection">CBD vape juice</a></span> and can be filled through the silicone stopper located on the side of each pod. Atop the pod is a duck billed mouthpiece which has been designed for a comfortable vaping experience. Airflow enters through the device itself, three 3mm diameter airflow slots can be found on each side of the SUPERGOOD where the pod enters. Internally, the SUPERGOOD replacement cartridge uses a 1.1 ohm coil. This 1.1 ohm coil is perfect for nicotine salt e-liquid and can be replaced at anytime.It is highly recommended to prime the coils and let sit for 5 to 8 minutes before using the pod, this will prevent dry hits and add life to the coil itself.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Read our newest blog article on "<span style="color: #3d85c6;"><a href="https://vapordna.com/blogs/news/why-we-created-supergood-pod-system" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color: #3d85c6;" target="_blank" title="Why We Created SuperGood Pod System Blog Article">Why We Created SuperGood Pod System</a></span>".</p>

<div data-description='&lt;h2 style="font-size: 14px;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;SUPERGOOD Portable Vape Pod System&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;
&lt;center&gt;
&lt;div&gt;
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;1st POD SYSTEM UNDER $10 BUCKS!&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/center&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;center&gt;
&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Affordable, Attainable, Powerful&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;/center&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;center&gt;
&lt;p&gt;&lt;b&gt;Only Pod System You Will Ever Need!&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;p&gt;&lt;b&gt;#ValueMatters #BestBangForYourBuckPod #First10DollarsPod #RedefineAffordability #VapeandSmile #VapeWhileSave #EcoFriendlyVape #VaporDNACares #VaporDNAFirstPod&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;p style="text-align: left;"&gt;The SUPERGOOD by &lt;span&gt;VaporDNA&lt;/span&gt; is an affordable &lt;span style="color: #3d85c6;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/pod-systems" target="_blank" title="Shop all vape pod systems" style="color: #3d85c6;" rel="noopener noreferrer"&gt;pod system&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt; that has two power output modes, a 460mAh battery, and &lt;span style="color: #3d85c6;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://vapordna.com/products/supergood-replacement-coils" target="_blank" title="SUPERGOOD Replacement Coils" style="color: #3d85c6;" rel="noopener noreferrer"&gt;replacement coils&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt; for its &lt;span style="color: #3d85c6;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://vapordna.com/products/supergood-replacement-cartridge" target="_blank" title="SUPERGOOD Replacement Cartridge" style="color: #3d85c6;" rel="noopener noreferrer"&gt;pod&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;. This device will give users amazing flavor due to the restricted, yet comfortable airflow. Being constructed with zinc alloy and polycarbonate, the SUPERGOOD excels at both durability and lightweight applications.&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;p style="text-align: left;"&gt;The SUPERGOOD features a mutli-angular chassis with rounded edges. An LED light indicator is located on the bottom of the device and will only activate when the device is fired. This LED light indicator will light up green if the integrated 460mAh battery on the device is above 3.5V and it will light up red if it is lower than 3.5V. Located on the side of the SUPERGOOD, adjacent to the LED light indicator is a USB cable port; This cable port is only meant for charging and takes approximately 60 minutes to fully charge the device. An unique feature implemented on the SUPERGOOD is a variable output mode system, Strong and Normal. To switch between the two output modes, users must draw on the device five times within five seconds and the LED light will correspond to the mode; Green is normal mode while White is strong mode. Normal Mode runs the SUPERGOOD at 10W while Strong Mode runs the device at 15W; Both output modes are suited for the atomizer resistance of 1.1 ohms.&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;p style="text-align: left;"&gt;The SUPERGOOD uses a proprietary replacement pod and coil system. This replaceable pod can accommodate a maximum of 2ml &lt;span style="color: #3d85c6;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/nicotine-salt-ejuices" target="_blank" title="Shop all Nicotine Salts" style="color: #3d85c6;" rel="noopener noreferrer"&gt;Nicotine Salt&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt; E-Liquid, regular &lt;span style="color: #3d85c6;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/e-liquids" target="_blank" title="Shop all E-liquids" style="color: #3d85c6;" rel="noopener noreferrer"&gt;freebase E-liquid&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt; or &lt;span style="color: #3d85c6;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/cbd-vape-juice" target="_blank" title="CBD Vape Juice Collection" style="color: #3d85c6;" rel="noopener noreferrer"&gt;CBD vape juice&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt; and can be filled through the silicone stopper located on the side of each pod. Atop the pod is a duck billed mouthpiece which has been designed for a comfortable vaping experience. Airflow enters through the device itself, three 3mm diameter airflow slots can be found on each side of the SUPERGOOD where the pod enters. Internally, the SUPERGOOD replacement cartridge uses a 1.1 ohm coil. This 1.1 ohm coil is perfect for nicotine salt e-liquid and can be replaced at anytime.It is highly recommended to prime the coils and let sit for 5 to 8 minutes before using the pod, this will prevent dry hits and add life to the coil itself.&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;p style="text-align: left;"&gt;Read our newest blog article on "&lt;span style="color: #3d85c6;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://vapordna.com/blogs/news/why-we-created-supergood-pod-system" target="_blank" title="Why We Created SuperGood Pod System Blog Article" style="color: #3d85c6;" rel="noopener noreferrer"&gt;Why We Created SuperGood Pod System&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;".&lt;/p&gt;

This 1.1 ohm coil is perfect for nicotine salt e-liquid and can be replaced at anytime.It is highly recommended to prime the coils and let sit for 5 to 8 minutes before using the pod, this will <p>The Aegis Squonk Starter Kit by <a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/geekvape" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank" title="Shop Geekvape Collection"><span style="color: #00aaff;">GeekVape</span></a> is a 100W box mod that is designed to be both durable and reliable for on the go applications, featuring military standard 810G-516.6 shockproof system and an IP67 waterproof and dustproof system, and can be powered by using a single <a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/18650-battery" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank" title="Shop 18650 Batteries"><span style="color: #00aaff;">high amperage 18650</span></a> <b>(sold separately)</b>, alongside the Aegis Squonk is the Tengu RDA; a rebuildable dripping atomizer with a 6mm deep e-juice well and bottom feed capabilities. The USB port is safely covered on the side of the device, secured by a thick silicone tab. The batteries are safely secured in with a threaded bottom latch battery door equipped with seal ring to keep it protected from from the elements.</p>
<p>GeekVape didn't forget about the rebuilding community in their latest rendition of the Aegis line. This Squonk mod features the AS-100 Chipset, and a OLED display which shows vape stats including resistance, amps, voltage, puff counter, and battery life indicator. With the Aegis Squonk is the Tengu RDA; a 24mm diameter atomizer that utilizes a bottom feed system and is able to fit two large clapton coils. <a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/e-liquids" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank" title="Shop E-Liquids"><span style="color: #00aaff;">E-Liquid</span></a> can be filled through a top slide to fill port located on the mod which features an easy access silicone plug. The bottle found in the Aegis Squonk is capable of holding 10ml of E-Juice. Being that this device is made for rough conditions the bottle is secured with the use of 4 hex screws which can be taken out with the included hex tool found within the contents of the packaging. The Aegis Squonk 100W Box Mod along with the Tengu Rebuildable Atomizer is a match made in heaven, designed for Rebuildable enthusiasts or new users looking to try their hand at a Squonking setup. The powerful AS-100 Chipset, multitude of functions, and protections form the perfect tough starter kit.</p>

&lt;p&gt;The Aegis Squonk Starter Kit by &lt;a href=&quot;https://vapordna.com/collections/geekvape&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; title=&quot;Shop Geekvape Collection&quot; rel=&quot;noopener noreferrer&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #00aaff;&quot;&gt;GeekVape&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/a&gt; is a 100W box mod that is designed to be both durable and reliable for on the go applications, featuring military standard 810G-516.6 shockproof system and an IP67 waterproof and dustproof system, and can be powered by using a single &lt;a href=&quot;https://vapordna.com/collections/18650-battery&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot; title=&quot;Shop 18650 Batteries&quot; rel=&quot;noopener noreferrer&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #00aaff;&quot;&gt;high amperage 18650&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/a&gt; &lt;b&gt;(sold separately)&lt;/b&gt;, alongside the Aegis Squonk is the Tengu RDA; a rebuildable dripping atomizer with a 6mm deep e-juice well and bottom feed capabilities. <p><span style="color: #3d85c6;"><a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/smok" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color: #3d85c6;" target="_blank" title="SMOK Collection Page">SMOK</a></span> presents the RPM40, a <span style="color: #3d85c6;"><a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/pod-systems" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color: #3d85c6;" target="_blank" title="Shop all vape pod systems">pod system</a></span> the resembles a standard box mod designed for big power output and maximum battery life. This features a 40W output, Mesh coils for <span style="color: #3d85c6;"><a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/nicotine-salt-ejuices" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color: #3d85c6;" target="_blank" title="Shop all Nic Salts">salt nicotine</a></span>, and a large 1500mAh battery capacity. This device leaps over most of the pod systems on the market, creating a unique vaping experience.</p>
<p>The SMOK RPM40 measures 99mm by 25mm by 25mm and features a zinc alloy construction, making this device a solid every day user. The RPM40 utilizes three buttons to manipulate the controls. A single fire button is used for not only firing the device but allows users to select different options. The two smaller buttons located below the 0.96" TFT Display allow users to change the wattage from 1 to 40W, clear puff counter and change the background colors. The TFT screen gives the user an easy readout of battery life, power settings, puff counter, seconds counter, voltage output,and ohm level. Draining this devices battery will be a difficult matter since the battery capacity has been maximized to a huge 1500mAh integrated battery. Another handy feature is the utilization of Micro-USB for charging and updates to the IQ-R Chip.</p>
<p>Moving forward, the <span style="color: #1986bc;"><a href="https://vapordna.com/products/smok-rpm-replacement-pods" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color: #1986bc;" target="_blank" title="SMOK RPM Replacement Pods">SMOK RPM40 replacement pod</a></span> does not protrude completely out of the device. This system allows the RPM40 to remain sleek and flush with the pod installed while the whistle tip protrudes approximately 18mm for a comfortable vaping experience. Juice can be filled by unplugging a red silicone tab located on the side of the pod with a maximum juice capacity of 4.3ml. An added feature on the pod is the ability to utilize SMOK Nord replacement coils, which make for a great vaping experience while allowing more coil options. The other variation of coils designed for the RPM40 are the <a href="https://vapordna.com/products/smok-rpm-replacement-coils" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank" title="SMOK RPM Replacement Coils"><span style="color: #3291c1;">SMOK RPM40 replacement coils</span></a>. Which are designed specifically for the RPM40 Kit delivering smooth and flavorful vapor in every puff. Each pod is securely connected to the device via friction fit connection.</p>

<div data-description='&lt;h2 style="font-size: 14px;"&gt;&lt;b&gt;SMOK RPM 40 Pod Mod Kit&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/h2&gt;
&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style="color: #3d85c6;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/smok" target="_blank" title="SMOK Collection Page" style="color: #3d85c6;" rel="noopener noreferrer"&gt;SMOK&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt; presents the RPM40, a &lt;span style="color: #3d85c6;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://vapordna.com/collections/pod-systems" target="_blank" title="Shop all vape pod systems" style="color: #3d85c6;" rel="noopener noreferrer"&gt;pod system&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt; the resembles a standard box mod designed for big power output and maximum battery life. This features a 40W output, Mesh coils for &lt;span style="color: #3d85c6;"&gt;&lt;a title="Shop all Nic Salts" style="color: #3d85c6;" href="https://vapordna.com/collections/nicotine-salt-ejuices" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"&gt;salt nicotine&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;, and a large 1500mAh battery capacity. This device leaps over most of the pod systems on the market, creating a unique vaping experience.&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;p&gt;The SMOK RPM40 measures 99mm by 25mm by 25mm and features a zinc alloy construction, making this device a solid every day user. The RPM40 utilizes three buttons to manipulate the controls. A single fire button is used for not only firing the device but allows users to select different options. The two smaller buttons located below the 0.96" TFT Display allow users to change the wattage from 1 to 40W, clear puff counter and change the background colors. The TFT screen gives the user an easy readout of battery life, power settings, puff counter, seconds counter, voltage output,and ohm level. Draining this devices battery will be a difficult matter since the battery capacity has been maximized to a huge 1500mAh integrated battery. Another handy feature is the utilization of Micro-USB for charging and updates to the IQ-R Chip.&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Moving forward, the &lt;span style="color: #1986bc;"&gt;&lt;a href="https://vapordna.com/products/smok-rpm-replacement-pods" target="_blank" title="SMOK RPM Replacement Pods" style="color: #1986bc;" rel="noopener noreferrer"&gt;SMOK RPM40 replacement pod&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt; does not protrude completely out of the device. This system allows the RPM40 to remain sleek and flush with the pod installed while the whistle tip protrudes approximately 18mm for a comfortable vaping experience. Juice can be filled by unplugging a red silicone tab located on the side of the pod with a maximum juice capacity of 4.3ml. An added feature on the pod is the ability to utilize SMOK Nord replacement coils, which make for a great vaping experience while allowing more coil options. The other variation of coils designed for the RPM40 are the &lt;a href="https://vapordna.com/products/smok-rpm-replacement-coils" target="_blank" title="SMOK RPM Replacement Coils" rel="noopener noreferrer"&gt;&lt;span style="color: #3291c1;"&gt;SMOK RPM40 replacement coils&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/a&gt;. Which are designed specifically for the RPM40 Kit delivering smooth and flavorful vapor in every puff. Each pod is securely connected to the device via friction fit connection.&lt;/p&gt;

<h3 class="stamped-review-header-title">RPM 40! Love this device!</h3>
<p class="stamped-review-content-body">I bought this for myself in green a couple of weeks ago and just purchased another one in "Prism Chrome". I wanted a small vape with great flavor to throw in my purse for on the go. It's lightweight enough for my purse and perfect for a pocket too. I am impressed with the great flavor from the rpm 40 mesh coils! I vape 3 mg. e-liquid and the flavor is WOW! I haven't tried the other pod yet that is more geared for MTL but will update when I do. So glad I can leave my bigger mods at home now. This kit packs a punch! </p>

Don’t worry, though, CBD is a non-psychoactive compound so <strong>CBD does not get you high</strong>. The psychoactive component of cannabis is called THC, and while it does have some of its own medicinal properties, it’s an intoxicating experience that not everybody wants or needs.</span></p><p><span><strong>CBD VS THC</strong></span></p><p>A common misconception is that CBD comes from the marijuana plant. While you can get CBD from a marijuana plant, it is most often extracted from the hemp plant (a cousin of the marijuana plant).</p><p>Keep in mind, any CBD made from the marijuana plant is illegal because that species of plant is illegal. Any CBD derived from hemp is legal in the 47 states who have legalized it.</p><p>The biggest difference between CBD and THC is how they react with the human endocannabinoid system. While CBD will give you some of the amazing benefits associated with using marijuana, it will not give you the buzzed feeling!</p><p><strong><span>Where does CBD come from?</span></strong></p><p><span>CBD is a compound commonly found in cannabis plants, but it does not create any of the psychotropic effects that people typically associate with cannabis. Everything you’ll find in the VaporDNA CBD Store is going to be derived from hemp, which is the male version of the plant that generates negligible amounts of THC, essentially eliminating any psychoactivity.</span></p><p><strong><span>How does CBD work? How can I benefit from it? </span></strong></p><p><span>CBD supports and stimulates your endocannabinoid system. The endocannabinoid system is a series of receptors all throughout the human body that require cannabinoids to achieve balance. This system affects everything from your mood to how well you’ll be able to fight off certain viruses.</span></p><p><span>Studies have shown that CBD can shrink cancer cells and is often used by people that commonly experience seizures, but it can also help with relatively minor problems such as muscle pain, headaches, or anxiety. </span><span>It’s anti-inflammatory properties make CBD perfect for muscle soreness, and the anti-anxiety effects can help with relaxation, among many other positive effects.</span></p><p><strong><a href="https://vapordna.com/blogs/news/is-cbd-legal" rel="noopener" target="_blank" title="CBD Blog Article"><span style="color: #3d85c6;">Isn’t cannabis illegal?</span></a></strong></p><p><span>Yes… but also no. What’s illegal is marijuana, the female version of the plant that creates an abundance of both THC and CBD when cultivated correctly. These are the plants that are legal in states where cannabis is legal recreationally, as they can serve both recreational and medical purposes.</span></p><p><span>When we’re talking about CBD, however, we’re talking about a compound that can also be found in hemp, the male version of cannabis that creates negligible levels of THC(0.3%), eliminating the “high” that people might be avoiding. Don’t worry, though, CBD is a non-psychoactive compound so <strong>CBD does not get you high</strong>. The psychoactive component of cannabis is called THC, and while it does have some of its own medicinal properties, it’s an intoxicating experience that not everybody wants or needs.</span></p><p><span><strong>CBD VS THC</strong></span></p><p>A common misconception is that CBD comes from the marijuana plant. While you can get CBD from a marijuana plant, it is most often extracted from the hemp plant (a cousin of the marijuana plant).</p><p>Keep in mind, any CBD made from the marijuana plant is illegal because that species of plant is illegal. Any CBD derived from hemp is legal in the 47 states who have legalized it.</p><p>The biggest difference between CBD and THC is how they react with the human endocannabinoid system. While CBD will give you some of the amazing benefits associated with using marijuana, it will not give you the buzzed feeling!</p><p><strong><span>Where does CBD come from?</span></strong></p><p><span>CBD is a compound commonly found in cannabis plants, but it does not create any of the psychotropic effects that people typically associate with cannabis. Everything you’ll find in the VaporDNA CBD Store is going to be derived from hemp, which is the male version of the plant that generates negligible amounts of THC, essentially eliminating any psychoactivity.</span></p><p><strong><span>How does CBD work? How can I benefit from it? </span></strong></p><p><span>CBD supports and stimulates your endocannabinoid system. The endocannabinoid system is a series of receptors all throughout the human body that require cannabinoids to achieve balance. This system affects everything from your mood to how well you’ll be able to fight off certain viruses.</span></p><p><span>Studies have shown that CBD can shrink cancer cells and is often used by people that commonly experience seizures, but it can also help with relatively minor problems such as muscle pain, headaches, or anxiety. </span><span>It’s anti-inflammatory properties make CBD perfect for muscle soreness, and the anti-anxiety effects can help with relaxation, among many other positive effects.</span></p><p><strong><a href="https://vapordna.com/blogs/news/is-cbd-legal" rel="noopener" target="_blank" title="CBD Blog Article"><span style="color: #3d85c6;">Isn’t cannabis illegal?</span></a></strong></p><p><span>Yes… but also no. What’s illegal is marijuana, the female version of the plant that creates an abundance of both THC and CBD when cultivated correctly. These are the plants that are legal in states where cannabis is legal recreationally, as they can serve both recreational and medical purposes.</span></p><p><span>When we’re talking about CBD, however, we’re talking about a compound that can also be found in hemp, the male version of cannabis that creates negligible levels of THC(0.3%), eliminating the “high” that people might be avoiding. Hemp-derived CBD is legal in all 50 states in the US, Canada, and many European countries among other places around the globe. </span></p><p><strong><span>How much is one dose of CBD?</span></strong></p><p><span>The dosage will vary depending on the severity of the ailment. It’s often recommended to start with something between five and ten milligrams for your first dose of CBD. If you’re using it for pain, try something on the higher end of that scale at first, as you want to make sure it takes care of the problem to avoid discomfort. Don’t worry, though, CBD is a non-psychoactive compound so <strong>CBD does not get you high</strong>. The psychoactive component of cannabis is called THC, and while it does have some of its own medicinal properties, it’s an intoxicating experience that not everybody wants or needs.</span></p><p><span><strong>CBD VS THC</strong></span></p><p>A common misconception is that CBD comes from the marijuana plant. While you can get CBD from a marijuana plant, it is most often extracted from the hemp plant (a cousin of the marijuana plant).</p><p>Keep in mind, any CBD made from the marijuana plant is illegal because that species of plant is illegal. Any CBD derived from hemp is legal in the 47 states who have legalized it.</p><p>The biggest difference between CBD and THC is how they react with the human endocannabinoid system. While CBD will give you some of the amazing benefits associated with using marijuana, it will not give you the buzzed feeling!</p><p><strong><span>Where does CBD come from?</span></strong></p><p><span>CBD is a compound commonly found in cannabis plants, but it does not create any of the psychotropic effects that people typically associate with cannabis. Everything you’ll find in the VaporDNA CBD Store is going to be derived from hemp, which is the male version of the plant that generates negligible amounts of THC, essentially eliminating any psychoactivity.</span></p><p><strong><span>How does CBD work? How can I benefit from it? </span></strong></p><p><span>CBD supports and stimulates your endocannabinoid system. The endocannabinoid system is a series of receptors all throughout the human body that require cannabinoids to achieve balance. This system affects everything from your mood to how well you’ll be able to fight off certain viruses.</span></p><p><span>Studies have shown that CBD can shrink cancer cells and is often used by people that commonly experience seizures, but it can also help with relatively minor problems such as muscle pain, headaches, or anxiety. </span><span>It’s anti-inflammatory properties make CBD perfect for muscle soreness, and the anti-anxiety effects can help with relaxation, among many other positive effects.</span></p><p><strong><a href="https://vapordna.com/blogs/news/is-cbd-legal" rel="noopener" target="_blank" title="CBD Blog Article"><span style="color: #3d85c6;">Isn’t cannabis illegal?</span></a></strong></p><p><span>Yes… but also no. What’s illegal is marijuana, the female version of the plant that creates an abundance of both THC and CBD when cultivated correctly. These are the plants that are legal in states where cannabis is legal recreationally, as they can serve both recreational and medical purposes.</span></p><p><span>When we’re talking about CBD, however, we’re talking about a compound that can also be found in hemp, the male version of cannabis that creates negligible levels of THC(0.3%), eliminating the “high” that people might be avoiding. &lt;strong&gt;FROSTY WATERMELON&lt;/strong&gt;
&lt;p&gt;If you need something a little more funky and fun in your CBD vape pen cartridge, then Funky Farms has developed the Frosty Watermelon flavor just to help you get grooving. Rich in terpenes and full on flavor, Frosty Watermelon combines the natural cannabis terps with CBD and MCT oil for a one-of-a-kind vape experience&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;strong&gt;GRANDDADDY PURPLE&lt;/strong&gt;
&lt;p&gt;A truly relaxing experience, the Granddaddy Purple flavored CBD cartridge is rich in cannabis terpenes that will have you dropping all that extra baggage from the day’s stress. Mixed with a full spectrum hemp extract, the Granddaddy Purple cartridge from Funky Farms is not one you want to miss.&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;strong&gt;GELATO&lt;/strong&gt;
&lt;p&gt;With the power of full spectrum hemp extracted CBD, combined with the natural flavors of cannabis terpenes and MCT oil. With 350mg of concentrate per cartridge, this Funky Farms product is sure to last you as long as you need, and to be delicious all throughout.&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;strong&gt;LEMON CAKE&lt;/strong&gt;
&lt;p&gt;If you need a dessert vape that isn’t going to melt you into the couch, the Lemon Cake vape cartridge from Funky Farms provides a buzzy mood boost. And with full-spectrum hemp extract, things will never get too racy, but they will bring a lift that you can’t always get from a cup of coffee.&lt;/p&gt;
&lt;strong&gt;THIN MINT&lt;/strong&gt;
&lt;p&gt;Just like your favorite cookie that comes to your doorstep, the Chocolate Mint flavor CBD cartridge from Funky Farms is a delicious little treat. Highly concentrated terpenes, MCT Oil, and CBD extract, these cartridges are reliable as they are tasty, and every bit as effective as you need.&lt;/p&gt;
